Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

travel — to go from one place to another. Example: Next summer we are going to travel to Italy.
holiday — a period of rest away from home. Example: Where are you going on holiday?
country — an area of land with its own government. Example: Which country do you want to visit?
city — a large town. Example: The city is bigger than the village.
visit — to go to see a person or place. Example: I am going to visit my grandmother.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Next summer I am going to ...
• We are going to visit ...
• It is a two-week holiday.
• Which country?
• My plan is ready.
